idea-plugin.name: CanFx Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Generates CRUD (CQRS) code from an entity in solutions created with the CanFx template: right-click an entity in the Domain project and choose CanFx: Generate CRUD.

Generated for the entity:

  • Create / Update / Delete commands and GetById / GetList (paged and dynamic) queries, each with its validator and response
  • business rules, messages and permission constants
  • EF Core configuration, repository and mapping profile
  • API controller endpoints

Optional mechanisms: caching, logging, transaction, secured operation and dynamic query. Places that need your input are marked with TODO(canfxgen).

The code is generated by the canfxgen command line tool, which this plugin calls: dotnet tool install -g CanFx.Generator

Source code: github.com/oguzhan-c/Generator (MIT)

Türkçe: CanFx şablonuyla oluşturulmuş çözümlerde entity'ye sağ tıklayarak CRUD (CQRS) kodu üretir. Kodu canfxgen aracı üretir; eklenti onu çağırır ve üretilen dosyaları açar.

action.description: Generates CRUD code for the selected entity (canfxgen crud)
